tools.name: matchmake_agent_crew
tools.description: Rank live heartbeat-verified MCP and A2A endpoints using 64-bit MGLE-NNP bitwise capability masks and return either a provider-diverse shortlist or a 3-agent complementary crew (Compute + Domain + Verifier) with single-use execution tickets. Use when selecting callable agents for a task; use search_

tools.name: search_agent_directory
tools.description: Browse and filter the audited Radial Switchboard phonebook by keyword substring and Virginia Scout health grade without consuming matchmaking call quota. Use when exploring catalog coverage by name, vendor, or grade; use matchmake_agent_crew instead when ranking capability-matched finalists for exec

tools.name: get_agent_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve the complete 4-point Virginia Scout runtime heartbeat audit, measured RTT latency, 64-bit MGLE-NNP coupler breakdown, and SHA-256 tool-schema hash for one exact agent_id. Use only when inspecting a known agent_id; use search_agent_directory if you need to find the agent_id first.

tools.name: get_switchboard_telemetry
tools.description: Return global US-EAST4 switchboard health, Grade A/B/D/E/F pool counts, autonomous registry crawl cursor state, and external hook telemetry. Use for system-wide status and pool metrics; use get_agent_dossier for an individual agent.

tools.name: register_agent_endpoint
tools.description: Submit a public HTTPS MCP or A2A endpoint for immediate live SSRF-guarded Virginia Scout interrogation, 64-bit MGLE-NNP grading, and directory indexing. Use when enrolling a new server or appealing a quarantined grade; do not use for private localhost/RFC1918 URLs.

tools.name: report_execution_outcome
tools.description: Submit a single-use HMAC execution_ticket from matchmake_agent_crew to record empirical downstream task completion or failure (+0.05 clean delivery / -0.20 timeout or schema failure on Byte-2 Guarantee grade). Use after invoking a matched agent to close the quality feedback loop.
